Variability of organ-biased genes (observed vs. randomized) (Lepisosteus oculatus)

Bucao, Christabel Floi

2026-05-07

Setup

Parameters

print(params)

Libraries

library(dplyr)

Functions

source("../functions/organ_bias.R")
source("../functions/organ_bias_plots.R")

Data

Multiple pairwise comparisons

if (!params$combat) {
  if (!params$qc1.only) {
    input.path <- file.path(params$input.rds.path, "no_combat", "full_qc")    
  } else {
    input.path <- file.path(params$input.rds.path, "no_combat", "qc1_only")        
  }

} else {
  if (!params$qc1.only) {
    input.path <- file.path(params$input.rds.path, "combat", "full_qc")    
  } else {
    input.path <- file.path(params$input.rds.path, "combat", "qc1_only")    
  }

}

# Load results of multiple pairwise comparisons from 12_Organ_Bias.Rmd
## Mean expression
comparisons.mean.expr.list <- vector(mode="list", length=3)
names(comparisons.mean.expr.list) <- c("observed", paste0("rnd",params$seed.run1), paste0("rnd",params$seed.run2))

comparisons.mean.expr.list[["observed"]] <- readRDS(
  file.path(input.path,
            paste(params$species, "comparisons.mean.expr",
                  paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))

comparisons.mean.expr.list[[paste0("rnd",params$seed.run1)]] <- readRDS(
  file.path(input.path,
            paste(params$species, "comparisons.mean.expr",
                  paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff),
                        paste0("rnd", params$seed.run1), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))   

comparisons.mean.expr.list[[paste0("rnd",params$seed.run2)]] <- readRDS(
  file.path(input.path,
            paste(params$species, "comparisons.mean.expr",
                  paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff),
                        paste0("rnd", params$seed.run2), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))

Main

Mean expression

Bind results

wilcox.mean.expr.bind <- list()

wilcox.mean.expr.bind$complete <- 
  bind_pairwise_comparisons_observed_vs_random(comparisons.mean.expr.list, apply.pvalue.cutoff=FALSE)
wilcox.mean.expr.bind$signif <- 
  bind_pairwise_comparisons_observed_vs_random(comparisons.mean.expr.list, apply.pvalue.cutoff=TRUE, adj.p=0.05)

Plot - Heatmap

# Looks much better in the HTML document than the RStudio console
heatmap_effect_size_combined_comparisons_blue2red(
  wilcox.df=wilcox.mean.expr.bind$complete, 
  cross.species=FALSE, species=params$species.name,
  value="mean", adj.p=0.05)

heatmap_effect_size_combined_comparisons(
  wilcox.df=wilcox.mean.expr.bind$signif, 
  cross.species=FALSE, species=params$species.name, value="mean")

Save

if (!params$combat) {
  if (!params$qc1.only) {
    output.path <- file.path(params$output.rds.path, "no_combat", "full_qc")    
  } else {
    output.path <- file.path(params$output.rds.path, "no_combat", "qc1_only")        
  }

} else {
  if (!params$qc1.only) {
  output.path <- file.path(params$output.rds.path, "combat", "full_qc")    
  } else {
  output.path <- file.path(params$output.rds.path, "combat", "qc1_only")        
  }

}

if (!dir.exists(output.path)) { dir.create(output.path, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE) }

saveRDS(wilcox.mean.expr.bind,
        file.path(output.path, 
                  paste(params$species, "wilcox.mean.expr.bind",
                        paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))                             

saveRDS(wilcox.log2cv.bind,
        file.path(output.path, 
                  paste(params$species, "wilcox.log2cv.bind",
                        paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))                           

saveRDS(wilcox.resid.var.bind,
        file.path(output.path, 
                  paste(params$species, "wilcox.resid.var.bind",
                        paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))                           

saveRDS(wilcox.expr.var.bind,
        file.path(output.path, 
                  paste(params$species, "wilcox.expr.var.bind",
                        paste(paste0("tau", params$tau.cutoff), "rds", sep="."), sep="_")))
